title: Jubilant Herbal French Pork Knuckle Stew
description: A fragrant, low-sodium stew featuring tender pork knuckle and fresh herbs, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: Season the pork knuckle with pepper and sear it in olive oil until browned on all sides.
Transfer the seared knuckle to a Dutch oven and add diced onion and minced garlic, cooking until onion is translucent.
Stir in sliced carrots and celery, and pour in white wine, scraping up any browned bits.
Add low-sodium chicken broth, thyme sprigs, bay leaf, and rosemary, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, cooking for 1 hour 30 minutes until the meat is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven, take out the knuckle, and allow it to rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Return the sliced pork to the pot, adjust seasoning with pepper if needed, and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
Stir in fresh parsley before serving, ensuring the stew is hot and fragrant.
Serve the stew hot, accompanied by crusty baguette or boiled potatoes if desired.
